int_name: S CHRISTOPHER COLUMBUS BLVD & SNYDER AVE

result.summary: The image shows a wide arterial road with a high-visibility crosswalk but a dangerously long unprotected crossing distance. The lack of a pedestrian refuge island and the high-speed design of the multi-lane roadway create a hostile environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Excessive crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least six lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image, spanning the width of the roadway.

hazards.name: High-speed road geometry
hazards.description: The wide, straight lanes and lack of vertical elements or physical medians encourage high vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of travel lanes to slow traffic and provide space for wider sidewalks or protected bike lanes.

result.summary: The image depicts a wide, multi-lane arterial intersection designed primarily for high-volume vehicle traffic, including heavy trucks. Pedestrian infrastructure is minimal, characterized by long crossing distances across at least four lanes without visible refuge islands or protective barriers.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must traverse a very wide roadway with multiple lanes, increasing exposure time to moving vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground and mid-ground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Heavy Vehicle Traffic
hazards.description: The presence of large semi-trucks increases the risk of severe or fatal injury and creates significant blind spots.
hazards.location_in_image: Large truck moving through the center of the intersection

hazards.name: High-Speed Roadway Design
hazards.description: Wide lanes and lack of traffic calming measures encourage higher vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to provide a safe waiting area and allow pedestrians to cross the wide road in stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Upgrade the faint transverse lines to high-visibility continental or ladder markings to increase driver awareness.

result.summary: The image depicts a wide, multi-lane arterial road with a signalized intersection that lacks basic pedestrian crossing infrastructure. While a sidewalk and bike lane are present, the absence of marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals creates a hostile environment for anyone attempting to cross the roadway.

hazards.name: Missing Crosswalk
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks at this signalized intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross unmarked lanes of traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway at the intersection

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The roadway is extremely wide with at least four travel lanes plus a bike lane, increasing exposure time for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No pedestrian signal heads are visible to provide dedicated crossing phases or countdowns.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks across all legs of the intersection.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear right-of-way information.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install directional curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at all crossing points.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized intersection in a commercial area with basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, a marked zebra crosswalk, and pedestrian signals.
